# Canonical field registry

The 3 types the binary ships, and every canonical field of each. A field name not listed under a type must carry a vendor's or a pipeline's prefix. Each type's own page adds how a record is keyed, tier by tier, and the relations its fields mint.

| Type | Kind | Keyed by | Fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`company`](/reference/fields/company) | subject: what a pipeline delivers to | `company_domain`, then `company_name` | 6 |
| [`person`](/reference/fields/person) | subject: what a pipeline delivers to | `email`, then `linkedin_url`, then `github_username`, then `twitter_handle`, then (`full_name` or `first_name` + `last_name`) and `company_domain` | 32 |
| [`post`](/reference/fields/post) | signal: what a pipeline finds and traverses from | `url` | 7 |

## company

| Field | Tier | Type | Normalization | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `company_domain` | identity | string | `domain` | Registrable domain (eTLD+1). Identity tier 1 for companies (SPEC.md §4). |
| `company_name` | identity | string | `trim` | Company name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier (SPEC.md §4). |
| `company_website` | core | string (uri) | `trim` | Website URL as provided. company_domain is the comparable form. |
| `company_linkedin_url` | core | string (uri) | `linkedin_url` | LinkedIn company page URL. |
| `company_employees` | core | integer | `none` | Headcount as an integer — never a range string. |
| `company_industry` | core | string | `trim` | Industry label. Value domain deferred until a second adapter forces comparability (rule of two). |

## person

| Field | Tier | Type | Normalization | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | identity | string (email) | `email` | Work or personal email. Identity tier 1 (SPEC.md §4). |
| `linkedin_url` | identity | string (uri) | `linkedin_url` | PUBLIC LinkedIn profile URL (vanity slug) only. Identity tier 2 via the derived slug. An internal-form or Sales-Navigator URL is an INVALID value for this field — those are linkedin_internal_url / linkedin_sales_nav_url (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); the shapes are separate fields precisely so they can never collide under one name. |
| `linkedin_internal_url` | core | string (uri) | `trim` | Internal-form LinkedIn profile URL (opaque token in the /in/ path, such as linkedin.com/in/ACwAA…). Stored as the URL, case preserved — gtme distinguishes observable URL shapes and does not reinterpret them as identifiers. NOT key material in v0 (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020): an enrichment that resolves it to the public profile writes linkedin_url, and the ordinary key upgrade applies. |
| `linkedin_sales_nav_url` | core | string (uri) | `trim` | Sales Navigator URL form (linkedin.com/sales/lead/… or /sales/people/…). Stored as the URL, case preserved. NOT key material in v0 (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); same recovery path as linkedin_internal_url. |
| `first_name` | identity | string | `trim` | Given name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier with last_name (SPEC.md §4). |
| `last_name` | identity | string | `trim` | Family name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier with first_name (SPEC.md §4). |
| `github_username` | identity, reserved | string | `handle` | GitHub username. Reserved identity tier 3, key prefix gh: (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); no v0 adapter provides it. |
| `twitter_handle` | identity, reserved | string | `handle` | Twitter/X handle without the @. Reserved identity tier 4, key prefix tw: (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); no v0 adapter provides it. |
| `full_name` | core | string | `trim` | Full display name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier when first/last are absent. |
| `title` | core | string | `trim` | Current job title, as stated. |
| `seniority` | core | string | `lower` | Seniority band, lowercased. No locked value domain in v0 — providers do not converge enough to pin one; a domain is declared only if real cross-provider evidence shows convergence (SPEC.md §4a). |
| `headline` | core | string | `trim` | Profile headline/tagline. |
| `about` | core | string | `trim` | Profile summary / about section. |
| `city` | core | string | `trim` | City of residence/work. |
| `state` | core | string | `trim` | State/region. |
| `country` | core | string | `trim` | Country. |
| `location` | core | string | `trim` | Free-form location string when a provider does not split city/state/country. |
| `company_name` | core | string | `trim` | Current employer's name. |
| `company_domain` | core | string | `domain` | Current employer's registrable domain (eTLD+1). The comparable, dedupe-safe form — never a full URL. Declares the works_at reference (ADR-054): a person record carrying it also names a company, keyed and populated from company_domain and company_name, and the runner writes works_at from the person to it. |
| `company_website` | core | string (uri) | `trim` | Current employer's website URL as provided. company_domain is the comparable form. |
| `company_linkedin_url` | core | string (uri) | `linkedin_url` | Current employer's LinkedIn company page URL. |
| `company_employees` | core | integer | `none` | Current employer's headcount as an integer — never a range string. An adapter whose provider reports a range maps it to a point estimate or omits the field. |
| `company_industry` | core | string | `trim` | Current employer's industry label. Value domain deferred until a second adapter forces comparability (rule of two). |
| `current_role` | core | string | `trim` | Current role as an enrichment provider states it (may differ from a source's title). |
| `current_company` | core | string | `trim` | Current employer as an enrichment provider states it. |
| `role_history` | core | array of string | `none` | Past roles, most recent first, one string per role. |
| `recent_posts` | core | array of string | `none` | Recent public post texts, most recent first. |
| `follower_count` | core | integer | `none` | Social follower count. |
| `open_to_work` | core | boolean | `none` | Whether the profile advertises being open to work. |
| `email_status` | core | string | `lower` | Email verification status as the providing adapter reports it. Waterfall-relevant; canonical value domain deferred until a second adapter forces comparability (rule of two). |
| `first_line` | core | string | `trim` | Composed personalized opening line, consumed by deliver steps. |
| `ps_line` | core | string | `trim` | Composed personalized P.S. line, consumed by deliver steps. |

## post

| Field | Tier | Type | Normalization | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | identity | string (uri) | `url` | The post's platform-public URL — the one key tier (SPEC.md §4, the url rule: scheme and host lowercased, fragment and trailing slash dropped, path and query kept). |
| `platform` | core | string | `lower` | The platform the post lives on, lowercased. No locked value domain yet (rule of two). |
| `text` | core | string | `trim` | The post's body text, as published. |
| `published_at` | core | string (date-time) | `trim` | When the post was published, RFC3339. |
| `likes` | core | integer | `none` | Reaction count at read time. |
| `comments` | core | integer | `none` | Comment count at read time. |
| `reposts` | core | integer | `none` | Repost/share count at read time. |

`Tier` is `identity` for a field a key is built from and `core` for the rest; `reserved` marks a key tier no adapter provides yet. `Normalization` is the rule that puts a value in its stored form.
